title: Who is Responsible? Data, Models, or Regulations, A Comprehensive Survey on Responsible Generative AI for a Sustainable Future

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating existing AI safety benchmarks using a custom 10-criterion rubric (specifically Criterion C1: Bias/Discrimination) to assess their coverage of allocational and representational harms across protected groups, and proposing lifecycle KPIs such as Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Disparate Impact (DI), and accuracy parity.

Reviewing real-world generative AI deployments, industry incidents, and literature to identify cultural insensitivity and alignment failures, particularly examining how models fail to capture local norms and values in education and agriculture.

Surveying sectoral applications to identify and categorize operational biases, such as discriminatory lending in finance, diagnostic bias in healthcare, and the exclusion of Global South farmers in agriculture, synthesizing these into a cross-domain maturity matrix.
